disclaimer: Context only — an AI reading of the radar's own deterministic output, not a signal. It feeds no score or allocation, can be wrong or overconfident, and every claim cites the radar evidence it is based on. Graded against the tape over time; treat as odds, not a forecast.

assessments.rationale: Real activity is unusually strong and broad: Congress net buying and lobbying each register 3.5, with additional support from material 8-K events at 1.523 and the regulatory pipeline at 0.763; the combined acceleration is 4.695 across four sources [P3]. Durability is promising but not yet proven because the theme is still forming and lacks a news leg, leaving open whether the surge persists [P1][P5]. Continuity favors entry: activity leads price by 2.645, while 60-day relative performance remains slightly negative at -6.11%, indicating that price has not yet fully reflected the activity [P2][P4].
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动信号强且来源广泛：国会净买入和游说活动均为3.5，重大8-K事件为1.523，监管进展为0.763，四类来源的综合加速度达到4.695 [P3]。持续性前景较好但尚未得到充分验证，因为主题仍处于形成阶段，且没有新闻推动 [P1][P5]。活动领先价格2.645，而过去60天相对大盘仍下跌6.11%，说明价格尚未充分反映这些变化，因此倾向进入，但信心为中等 [P2][P4]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government-related buying, lobbying, corporate disclosures, and regulatory activity are all picking up at the same time, with the first two showing especially strong increases. Prices have not followed yet: the group has trailed the market by about 6% over the past 60 days, creating a potentially attractive early entry. The main caution is that the move is still young and has no supporting news momentum, so position sizing should remain measured until the activity persists.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府相关买入、游说、公司重大披露和监管活动正在同步升温，其中前两项增幅尤其明显。价格尚未跟上，相关公司过去60天落后大盘约6%，因此目前可能是较早的介入时点。不过，这一趋势仍处于早期，也没有新闻热度配合，宜控制仓位并等待活动持续性得到确认。
assessments.dissent: The strongest counterargument is that the apparent surge may be temporary: the theme is only forming, has no news leg, and its two strongest inputs come from Congress and lobbying, while regulatory and corporate-event support is materially weaker [P1][P3][P5].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm the thesis if subsequent readings continue to show support from several independent sources and price begins outperforming the market, converting the current activity-price gap into confirmation [P2][P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm it if Congress buying and lobbying fall back without stronger regulatory or corporate-event activity, while relative performance remains negative or worsens [P3][P4].

assessments.name: Memory, HBM & Storage

assessments.rationale: Real activity is strong and broad: congressional net buying is exceptionally elevated (z=3.5), lobbying is ramping sharply (z=2.849), and the three-source fused acceleration is 2.819 [P3]. Persistence is less certain because material 8-K events are slightly negative (z=-0.455), the pattern is still forming, and there is no supporting news leg [P1][P3][P5]. Price has not yet followed: 60-day relative strength is -6.72% versus the market, while activity leads price by z=2.423, creating an actionable positive divergence rather than a price-confirmed trend [P1][P2][P4]. The signal spans AFRM, AXP, COF, CRCL, FI, FIS, FLYW, and FOUR, although the pack does not show how evenly activity is distributed among them [P6].
assessments.rationale_zh: 真实活动信号强且来源较广：国会议员净买入显著升高（z=3.5），游说活动快速上升（z=2.849），三类来源的综合加速度达到2.819 [P3]。持续性仍有疑问，因为重大8-K事件略偏弱（z=-0.455），当前形态仍处于形成阶段，而且没有新闻面的配合 [P1][P3][P5]。价格尚未跟上：过去60天相对大盘落后6.72%，而真实活动领先价格的程度达到z=2.423，因此目前更像具有入场价值的领先信号，而非已经得到价格确认的趋势 [P1][P2][P4]。覆盖范围包括AFRM、AXP、COF、CRCL、FI、FIS、FLYW和FOUR，但现有材料没有说明活动是否均匀分布于这些公司 [P6]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government-linked buying and lobbying activity around payments and financial technology companies are rising sharply across several measures, while company filings are not yet showing the same momentum. Prices have lagged the broader market by about 6.7% over the past 60 days, suggesting the real-world activity has not yet been fully reflected. A measured entry is reasonable, but conviction should remain moderate until corporate events or sustained follow-through confirm that this is more than an early burst.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 与支付和金融科技公司相关的政府人员买入及游说活动正在多个指标上明显升温，但公司重大公告尚未出现同样的动能。过去60天，这一领域的价格表现落后大盘约6.7%，说明现实活动可能尚未被价格充分反映。可以考虑谨慎入场，但在公司事件增多或活动持续升温之前，应保持中等信心。
assessments.dissent: The strongest opposing case is that the apparent momentum is concentrated in congressional buying and lobbying while material corporate events are slightly negative, there is no news support, and the pattern is only forming; without company-level confirmation, the divergence could remain unrecognized or reverse [P1][P3][P5].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Over the next update window, congressional buying and lobbying remain elevated, 8-K material-event activity turns positive, and relative price performance improves from the current -6.72% while activity continues to lead price [P2][P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Congressional buying or lobbying activity falls materially, fused acceleration loses its positive multi-source character, or relative performance deteriorates further without any improvement in 8-K events or news support [P3][P4][P5].

assessments.name: Payments & Fintech

assessments.rationale: Real activity is moderately strong but uneven: the fused acceleration is 1.406 across four sources, driven primarily by government contracts at 1.312, while congressional net buying (-0.389), material 8-K events (-0.18), and lobbying (0.0) provide no confirmation [P3]. Durability is uncertain because the signal is still forming, lacks a news leg, and depends heavily on one source rather than synchronized improvement [P1][P3][P5]. Price has not confirmed the activity: the sector trails the market by 4.32% over 60 days, while activity is modestly ahead of price [P2][P4]. The divergence is potentially constructive but too early and narrow to justify entry, so the appropriate stance is MONITOR [P1][P2][P3].
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动信号中等偏强但并不均衡：四类来源的综合加速度为1.406，主要由政府合同的1.312推动；国会议员净买入为-0.389，重大8-K事件为-0.18，游说活动为0.0，均未形成支持 [P3]。该趋势仍处于形成阶段、缺少新闻推动，而且主要依赖单一来源，因此持续性尚不确定 [P1][P3][P5]。价格尚未确认这一变化：过去60天该板块落后大盘4.32%，而现实活动仅温和领先价格 [P2][P4]。这种背离具有潜在吸引力，但目前过早且信号偏窄，宜继续观察 [P1][P2][P3]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government contracting activity related to communication-services companies has picked up meaningfully, but lobbying, corporate disclosures, and congressional buying are not reinforcing the move. Prices still trail the broader market by about 4.3% over the past 60 days, so investors have not yet endorsed the improvement. The setup is promising but too dependent on one source; watch for wider confirmation before buying.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 通信服务企业相关的政府合同活动明显升温，但游说、公司重大披露和国会议员交易并未同步改善。过去60天，该板块仍落后大盘约4.3%，说明投资者尚未确认这种变化。当前机会值得关注，但过度依赖单一来源，宜等待更多现实活动共同转强后再考虑买入。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish counterargument is that activity already leads price, with strong government-contract momentum and positive aggregate acceleration across four monitored sources; the sector's 4.32% relative underperformance could therefore represent unrecognized upside rather than weak confirmation [P2][P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade the thesis if subsequent readings show activity remaining ahead of price while at least one currently weak source—congressional buying, lobbying, or material corporate events—turns positive and relative performance begins improving [P2][P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Reject the thesis if government-contract momentum fades without support from the other three sources, or if relative performance deteriorates further while the activity-price divergence closes [P2][P3][P4].

assessments.name: Communication Services (Equal-Weight)

assessments.rationale: The signal is narrow rather than broadly strong: congressional net buying is exceptional at z=3.5, but lobbying is flat and material 8-K activity is below normal at z=-0.546; aggregate acceleration is only 0.152 across three sources [P3]. Persistence looks weak because the theme is fading [P1], lacks a news leg [P5], and its strength depends mainly on one source [P3]. Price has already strongly outperformed over 60 days, while real activity trails price materially (divergence z=-1.619), indicating that the narrative is running ahead of observable activity [P2][P4].
assessments.rationale_zh: 当前活动信号较为集中，而非全面走强：国会议员净买入异常强劲，但游说活动持平，重大8-K事件低于常态，三类来源的综合加速度仅为0.152 [P3]。持续性偏弱，因为主题已进入衰退阶段 [P1]，没有新闻推动 [P5]，主要依赖单一来源支撑 [P3]。过去60天价格相对大盘已显著走强，但现实活动明显落后于价格，说明市场叙事已跑在可观察活动之前 [P2][P4]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Congressional buying has risen sharply, but corporate disclosures are below normal and lobbying activity is flat, so the real-world pickup is narrow. Meanwhile, these companies have already outperformed the market strongly over the past two months, even though underlying activity has not kept pace. The safer course is to stay away for now and wait for corporate and lobbying activity to strengthen before reconsidering.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 国会议员买入力度明显上升，但企业重大披露低于常态，游说活动也没有增长，因此现实活动的改善较为单一。与此同时，这些公司过去两个月已经显著跑赢大盘，而实际活动并未同步跟上。现在更适合暂时回避，等待企业活动和游说投入共同转强后再考虑。
assessments.dissent: The strongest counterargument is that exceptional congressional net buying, combined with positive aggregate acceleration and strong relative price performance, may be an early signal that broader activity will follow [P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade the view if the next observation shows material 8-K activity turning positive and lobbying activity rising while aggregate acceleration strengthens, with real activity closing the gap to price [P2][P3].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Keep or strengthen the avoid stance if congressional buying normalizes without improvement in lobbying or material 8-K events, especially if aggregate acceleration turns negative or price continues rising while activity falls further behind [P2][P3][P4].

assessments.name: Non-AI Software

assessments.rationale: Real activity is weak across the most substantive channels: government contracts are below trend (z=-0.814) and congressional net buying is weaker still (z=-1.488), while lobbying, solicitations, material events, and news are essentially neutral [P3]. Durability is poor because the theme is classified as fading with NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE [P1], although positive fused acceleration and rising, entirely unscheduled news flow provide an early counter-signal [P3][P5]. Continuity is weak: 60-day relative strength is positive, but activity trails price materially (divergence z=-1.418), indicating that market performance is running ahead of observable activity [P2][P4]. Avoid until activity improves across multiple substantive sources rather than relying on price and news momentum alone [P3][P5].
assessments.rationale_zh: 实质活动信号偏弱：政府合同低于常态，国会议员净买入更弱，而游说、招标、重大事项和新闻信号大致处于中性水平 [P3]。持续性也不理想，因为主题已进入衰退阶段并呈负向背离 [P1]；不过综合加速度为正，且突发新闻流正在加快，构成初步反证 [P3][P5]。价格近60天相对市场走强，但实际活动明显落后于价格，说明行情已经跑在可观察活动之前 [P2][P4]。
assessments.rationale_plain: 政府合同和国会议员买入活动都低于常态，而游说、招标及企业重大事项没有明显升温。相关公司近60天跑赢了大盘，但现实活动尚未跟上，说明投资者的期待可能已经走在基本面之前。突发新闻正在增多，不过在合同或其他实质活动同步改善前，宜暂时回避。
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府合同和国会议员买入活动均低于常态，游说、招标和企业重大事项也没有明显升温。相关公司近60天跑赢大盘，但现实活动尚未跟上，说明市场预期可能已经领先于基本面。突发新闻正在增多，不过在合同或其他实质活动同步改善之前，宜暂时回避。
assessments.dissent: The strongest counterargument is that aggregate activity acceleration is already positive, news velocity and acceleration are both 0.6, and all observed news is unscheduled; these may be early signs that substantive activity will turn upward after the current measurement window [P3][P5].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade the view if subsequent readings show government contracts and congressional buying moving above trend, with at least one of lobbying, pre-award solicitations, or material events also turning meaningfully positive while activity closes the gap with price [P2][P3].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Retain or strengthen the avoidance view if contracts and congressional buying remain below trend, the currently neutral substantive sources fail to improve, and price continues outperforming despite activity remaining behind [P2][P3][P4].

assessments.name: AI Infrastructure

assessments.rationale: Real activity is mixed rather than broadly strong: congressional net buying and federal grant opportunities are positive, but material 8-K events and the regulatory pipeline are notably negative, while lobbying and news are flat [P3]. Although the combined activity measure is accelerating [P3] and news has positive velocity and acceleration with entirely unscheduled items [P5], the theme is classified as fading [P1], weakening the case for persistence. Price has already outperformed the market over 60 days [P4], while activity trails price materially [P2]; this negative divergence suggests the narrative may be priced ahead of its underlying activity [P1]. Monitor for broader confirmation rather than entering now.
assessments.rationale_zh: 真实活动信号喜忧参半：国会议员净买入和联邦拨款机会走强，但重大8-K事件和监管推进明显走弱，游说与新闻指标则没有改善[P3]。综合活动仍在加速[P3]，且新闻速度和加速度为正、全部来自非预定消息[P5]，但主题已进入衰退阶段[P1]，持续性存疑。价格过去60天已跑赢大盘[P4]，而真实活动明显落后于价格[P2]，说明市场叙事可能已提前反映；当前更适合观察，而非立即买入。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government grant opportunities and congressional buying are picking up, but company-reported material events and regulatory activity are weakening, while lobbying and overall news activity show little improvement. Prices have already outperformed the market even though the underlying activity has not kept pace. The recent burst of unscheduled news is encouraging, but the broader pattern is fading, so it is better to wait for wider confirmation before buying.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府拨款机会和国会议员买入有所增加，但企业披露的重大事项和监管活动正在走弱，游说与整体新闻活动也没有明显改善。相关股票近期已经跑赢大盘，而现实活动尚未跟上。近期突发消息增多带来一些希望，但整体势头仍在减弱，因此更适合等待更广泛的改善后再考虑买入。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish case is that the combined activity measure is accelerating across seven monitored sources [P3], supported by positive congressional buying and federal grant signals [P3], while unscheduled news shows positive velocity and acceleration [P5]; these could be early indications that real activity will catch up with already-strong price performance [P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade the narrative if subsequent observations show sustained positive combined acceleration, continued congressional buying and grant activity, and a turn upward in material events, solicitations, or regulatory activity while price remains firm [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Reject the narrative if combined acceleration turns negative, the congressional and grant signals fade, or material-event and regulatory weakness persists while price continues to outrun activity [P2][P3].

assessments.name: AI Semiconductors

rotation.summary: Leadership is rotating toward early-forming Memory/HBM/Storage, Payments/Fintech and equal-weight Communication Services, where activity leads price; confirmed mature leadership remains in Cybersecurity, AI Agents/Applications, Gold Miners and Robotics/Automation, while broad AI infrastructure/semis, mega-cap tech, energy and crypto are fading or price-led.
rotation.summary_zh: 领导力正转向处于形成期、实际活动领先价格的存储/HBM、支付金融科技和等权通信服务；网络安全、AI智能体与应用、黄金矿业及机器人自动化仍是已确认但较成熟的强势方向，而广泛AI基建/半导体、科技巨头、能源和加密主题正在衰退或仅由价格驱动。

watch: Whether the three forming POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE themes transition to CONFIRMED_UP, validating price participation.
Whether mature CONFIRMED_UP leaders—Cybersecurity, AI Agents & Applications, Gold Miners, and Robotics & Automation—retain confirmation or begin fading.
Whether NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE themes regain real-activity confirmation; absent that, price strength remains vulnerable.
Whether QUIET financial, industrial, defensive, semiconductor-equipment or consumer themes develop new positive divergence, signaling the next rotation.
